title: From bushcraft to ghost hunts: what's on in Gwent this weekend
excerpt: From bushcraft adventures to festive music, Pontypool and Newport have a packed schedule of events to enjoy this weekend.
content:
From bushcraft adventures to festive music, Pontypool and Newport have a packed schedule of events to enjoy this weekend.

Bushcraft At The Basin!

Try your hand at bushcraft with Rose from Gwent Wildlife Trust at Pontymoile Basin. This free taster session includes fire lighting, outdoor cooking, natural crafts, and shelter building. All ages are welcome but under 16s must be accompanied by an adult. Parking is available at the meeting point. Saturday, November 28, 10am to 2pm.

Christmas Concert

Celebrate the season at Pontypool Museum with an afternoon of Christmas music and singing from the Linden Singers and folk group Celtic Café. Refreshments will be available. Tickets are £5, with under 18s free. Saturday, November 28, 1.30pm to 3.30pm.

World AIDS Day Vigil

Join the World AIDS Day Vigil at The Wave Statue, Newport, in partnership with The Abbey of the Red Dragon and Terrence Higgins Trust Cymru. The event is open to all for remembrance and support, and donations will be collected for the Martyn Butler Fund. Saturday, November 28, 6.30pm to 7pm.

Official album launch - Peace Of Mind by Kevin Potter

Local singer/songwriter and banjo player Kevin Potter launches his new album, Peace Of Mind, at Lines Taproom And Noddfa in Usk. Enjoy live performances and stories behind the songs, with a collection for Mind. Free entry. Saturday, November 28, 8pm.

Caldicot Castle Paranormal Night

GhostlyGoingsOn hosts a night of paranormal exploration at Caldicot Castle, featuring ghost hunting, séance sessions, and a haunted expedition. Highlights include tales of shadow figures, bangs, and poltergeist activity. Tickets are £47 per person with a £20 deposit. Saturday, November 28, 8pm to Sunday, November 29, 2am.

Christmas Craft Fair

Get festive at Harvester Pontypool’s Christmas Craft Fair at Ty Felin Fawr, Lower Mill Field. Browse handmade gifts, festive decorations, and enjoy live brass band music while you shop. The organisers said: "Bring your friends and family and make a festive day of it! We can’t wait to see you there!" Sunday, November 29, 10am to 2pm.

Sleigh bells & Serenades

Experience a Christmas spectacular at ICC Wales in Newport, raising funds for children’s charities. Enjoy a 60-piece orchestra, the Llantrisant Male Voice Choir, guest singers, and surprises for an unforgettable evening. Tickets are £20-£25 from Ticketsource. Sunday, November 29, 7.30pm.

For further information visit the venue website.
